column1: # The FindSecBugs 1.14.0 injection sinks of path, SQL, command and LDAP patterns, measured by lab runs that hand
# every public method and constructor of the JDK, Spring JDBC, Spring LDAP, JPA, Guava, Commons IO and Commons Exec
# an unknown value at each position, with nitpicker's own sink files (languages/java/gradle/security) in place.
# pattern, owner, method, erased parameter types, the positions that are sinks (from 0). A call is a sink when the
# class it names or one of its supertypes has a row for its method; a row with pattern - stops the search there.
